title: fix(qa): shorten the order_to_cash card title.en under the 128-char displayName cap
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu3zQ2AqeghSGpv6Q7VEPDyQ)_

Fixes #35431

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户无感:场景卡库里"订单到收款"卡的英文标题缩短了几个词,导出到应用库时不再超长。
- 为了让该卡导出的 displayName 不超过 128 字符的上限。
- 出错只影响这一张卡的英文标题展示,可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么:无。

## What changes

- `docs/qa/scenarios/order_to_cash.json`: `title.en` 131 → 126 characters by dropping two articles ("an activity stream" → "activity stream", "a discount approval" → "discount approval"); every listed part stays nameable. `title.zh` is 37, unchanged.
- `packages/qa/scenarios/test/library.test.ts`: one assertion added to the existing card-shape test (`title.en.length <= 128`) so no card can regress past the `displayName` cap.

## Tests

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios exec vitest run test/library.test.ts` under the verify lock: 20/20 pass (VERDICT command-exit 0).

## Acceptance notes

- sha256 pin check: grepped the tree for the old card sha256 and the old title string; the only hit was the card file itself, so no in-tree pin needs updating. Records outside the tree (eval-run records) were not inspected or edited.
- The card ships in `@objectstack/scenarios` dist/library, so `.changeset/35431-order-to-cash-title.md` (patch) is added.

## Verification

Run `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios exec vitest run test/library.test.ts`; expect 20 passed.
